Ship's biscuit was a staple food for sailors and soldiers for centuries. Join us as we take a journey back in time to learn how this simple, hard, and durable bread sustained armies and navies during long voyages and battles.  …...más
...más
Resumen
Journey back in time to discover the surprisingly simple recipe for ship's biscuits, a crucial food source for 18th-century sailors and soldiers. This historical cooking demonstration details the process, from mixing the dough to baking the final product. Learn how these durable biscuits sustained travelers and troops during long journeys and battles.
